notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.7
notes.content:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.7[/h1][p][/p][p][b][i]Tycoons![/i]  We have just delivered Railway Empire 2’s Update 1.7 to Steam, Microsoft Store, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One consoles (supported through Smart Delivery). This update includes a new manual warehouse operation mode, a new [/b]gameplay option to disable “Small breakdowns” and fixes several gameplay and crash issues.  [b]
[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1644320/view/521968650881597975?l=english"][/dynamiclink][b] Please find the full Changelog below.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added an alternate warehouse operation mode. When “Automatic Distribution” is turned off, warehouses can be used as permanent stores (similar to how warehouses functioned in Railway Empire 1) and goods will no longer use them for automatic travel to their destination. Both modes are always available from the warehouse menu and a combination of both modes can be used on the same map. Only one warehouse set to one of the modes can be used per station.[/p][/*][*][p]Added: Difficulty setting “AI Behavior” in Custom Games. Minor improvements for the AI in custom games can now be enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Difficulty setting “Connection Bonus”. If set to “off”, there will be no connection bonuses offered during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Pause Auctions” to Options menu. When set to “on” the auction timer will pause when the game is paused AND the player is not the highest bidder in the current auction, so that they have time to react.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Gameplay option to disable “Small breakdowns”. Small breakdowns can occur for engines with a maintenance limit between 90% and 50%. If disabled, engines will never break down when above 50% maintenance limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Graphics Option “Moving Sun”. When enabled the sun always keeps the same angle in relation to the camera to ensure consistent scene lighting.[/p][/*][*][p]Locked regions are now always visible in track construction.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved terrain contrast overall to make hills and mountains more visible on high zoom levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new goods icons to task texts next to the spelled-out name of the good, to increase clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Goods that are on the way to a foundable rural business are now communicated by a tooltip, accessible via the corresponding interface, similar to the tooltip accessible via the stock and demand overview for existing cities.

[/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]Bug-Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a specific order of commands allowed the speed in ride-along camera to be higher than 1x game speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where people at stations were not always visible when using the ride-along camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue related to moving the camera before the automatic camera at the start of a new map is done.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused reduced FPS when changing a selected train to manual loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a wrong button was displayed, suggesting a “set maintenance limit” option being available at buildings unrelated to maintenance.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Localization] Fixed an issue where “Rice” was not correctly translated in Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where map decorations like boulders, ruins, small buildings, etc. would not vanish if the player laid track next to them. Trains now no longer clip through them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, when editing rail lines if too many goods were available in a city, they did not fit in the available space anymore, they will now slowly pan back and forth, so that all goods can be seen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rural businesses visible working areas were not adjusting based on business size anymore. Larger businesses now have more attached working areas again (e.g. fields or clay pits).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the train breaking sound effects were looped when pausing during playback.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Controller only Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]\[Controller only] Fixed a blocker in the first Tutorial when the user accidentally closed the rail line creation menu before building the first rail line.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Controller only] Removed a prompt to build overhead lines from rail builder when electrification was not active.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Controller only] Fixed an issue where Contour Lines did not reliably turn off correctly when leaving construction mode.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Controller only] Fixed an issue where the “Scroll” button legend was missing in some building screens.

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]DLC-specific Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]\[All DLCs] Region-specific fitting goods are now impacted by refrigerator cars.[/p][/*][*][p]\[All DLCs] Regional specific bridges are now applied to all DLC maps accordingly[/p][/*][*][p]\[High Voltage only] Fixed a very rare issue where extra overhead lines were spawned parallel to the tracks.

[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Spoiler: Addition of the NEW Alternative Warehouse – Mode
notes.content:
[h1][u]Spoiler:[/u] Addition of the NEW Alternative Warehouse – Mode[/h1][p] [/p][p][i][u]Tycoons![/u][/i][/p][p]Our next free Update, 1.7, will bring with it one of your biggest requests – an [b]alternative warehouse mode[/b].[/p][p]As we approach the release of the Industrial Wonders DLC, and alongside it Update 1.7, we wanted to give you a sneak peek![/p][p]We’ve heard your feedback about warehouses for a long time, and they have been one of the top topics on our list of player requests since release.

Now we are happy to deliver the adapted warehouse functionality you’ve been asking for—similar to what you may remember from the original Railway Empire.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42842808/3c15ebb1c72d5007fc2f12440f0d84a7c63da9d0.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3][b][u]What is the alternative Warehouse mode?[/u][/b][/h3][p]The newly introduced warehouse setting allows you to choose whether goods are distributed automatically, as was the case in Railway Empire 2 up until now, or a manual mode that allows you to store goods permanently until you decide to distribute them.[/p][p]With this [b]new setting[/b], you [b]can[/b] assign up to six goods per warehouse and define individual storage limits between 1 and 99 units for each.[/p][p]You [b]can[/b] also enable the new warehouse mode by [b]checking/unchecking[/b] the [b]“Automatic Distribution” - [/b]box in the warehouse menu.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42842808/c85a0001d51e8b07deb7a1b4b483a64c0ddfe74c.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3][b][u]Switching Modes in Existing Warehouses[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]When changing modes in pre-existing warehouses, here’s what happens: If you change the warehouse mode while goods are already selected but not stored, the goods stay selected.[/p][/*][*][p]If you change the warehouse mode from manual to automatic mode when goods are already stored in the warehouse, a warning will be displayed. Upon confirmation, all goods, except those already with a delivery destination, are deleted.[/p][/*][*][p]If you change a warehouse from the current system to the new manual mode, nothing will be lost and no wares will be deleted.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b][u]Good to know:[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]City-needs take priority over storing in the the local warehouse.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The new mode allows you to plan ahead in several situations that were not possible before. For example, a city does not need a good like Liquor yet, but will at a later point and you can produce more than you currently need. You can send Liquor to the warehouse, stock up on 99 units and as soon as the city needs the good, the city will use it from the warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]The new warehouses need to be managed manually more often in the manual workmode, and you need to keep an eye on them to ensure that everything is properly set up.[/p][/*][*][p]Veterans may find that a mixed version, with some manual and some automatic warehouses, to be the optimal strategy for their railway empire.[/p][/*][*][p]If you [b]change the warehouse mode back to automatic[/b], please note that already stored goods, without an already set destination will be removed. The game will warn you and will ask for confirmation.[/p][/*][*][p]After thorough playtesting, our quality assurance department has found that for many players the manual warehouse mode can have a positive impact on their ability to spot problems and errors on their routes more easily. With complex railroad networks, a lot of problems can be found by just checking the relevant warehouses. For example, if your city is not receiving the goods you want and the warehouse delivering the city is empty, you know that the route to the warehouse must be the fault.[/p][/*][*][p]As usual, [b]6 products can be selected[/b] for each warehouse in the new mode and the stock level can also be determined for each individual good (up to a maximum of 99).[/p][/*][*][p]If you want to [b]set up multiple warehouses that store the same goods with the manual workmode[/b], you need to be careful and ensure that the route does not deliver the goods back to the previous warehouses. If you forget to do this, you can easily create an endless cycle of sending goods back and forth between your warehouses. [/p][/*][*][p]The city uses the warehouse to fulfil its city demands and needs, including industry needs for raw materials. Industries can NOT automatically place produced goods (output) into the warehouse within its city.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added a [b]new paragraph on the help page for warehouses[/b] with additional details and explanations.[/p][/*][*][p]The city can use goods that are tagged as stored for city demands.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42842808/1cd07bfd03eb237a91a17ddc3ebb4ade5025ed82.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 Full Steam Ahead into the Industrial Revolution
notes.content:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 Full Steam Ahead into the Industrial Revolution[/h1]

Railway Empire 2 is expanding its horizons with the addition of the next DLC installment Industrial Wonders! [b]Enter the era of innovation June 24 on Steam, Xbox PC, PlayStation®4|5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One for €10.99 with an added 10% discount on Steam and the Kalypso Media store until July 8.[/b]
 
Welcome to the [b]Industrial Revolution[/b], where the railway reigns supreme in the period of advancement. Railway Empire 2 – Industrial Wonders, takes players on a journey through three critical hubs as production and use of the steam engine ushers in an age of productivity paving the way for complex supply chains, and monumental construction projects. 
Railway Empire 2 – [b]Industrial Wonders transports players to Germany, France, and the United States in three fully-voiced comprehensive scenarios “Ruhr Valley” (1860), “Eiffel Tower” (1889) and “Hoover Dam” (1931)[/b] as railroad companies flourish at the creation of ingenuity. Establish industrial facilities and forge effective railway links to ignite local prosperity and make the construction of monumental engineering marvels possible. 
Journey across [b]three high-resolution maps in the Ruhr Valley, Île-de-France, and the Hoover Dam area in three authentic powerhouse locomotives, including the iconic “Big Boy” and “Heavy Mike",[/b] ready to haul the heaviest loads and conquer the most challenging terrain. Traverse each historically significant region and achieve entrepreneurial greatness while listening to more than 15 new themed music tracks and jingles to be transported directly into the conductor’s seat of the era. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677590/Railway_Empire_2__Industrial_Wonders/

[b]Railway Empire 2 – Industrial Wonders pulls into the station June 24 on Steam, Xbox PC, PlayStation®4|5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One for €10.99[/b] with an added 10% discount on Steam and the Kalypso Media store until July 8.

[h3]Features: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Steaming Steel: Railway Empire 2 – Industrial Wonders takes players on an entrepreneurial journey to three pivotal hubs of the age of industrialisation.
[*] Heavy Duty: Utilize three authentic locomotives, including the iconic “Big Boy” and “Heavy Mikado”.
[*] Full Steam Ahead: The DLC introduces three comprehensive, fully voiced scenarios, “Ruhr Valley” (starting 1860), “Eiffel Tower” (starting 1889) and “Hoover Dam” (starting 1931)
[*] Shaping the Future: Prepare for the challenges of three new high-resolution maps of the Ruhr Valley, Île-de-France, and the Hoover area.

[*] Heavy Tunes: More than 15 new themed music tracks and jingles to get you in the mood for the new environment and locomotives.
[/list]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 – Bella Italia Delivers a Taste of Italian Elegance

[h1]Railway Empire 2 – Bella Italia Delivers a Taste of Italian Elegance[/h1]

Today we have released Railway Empire 2 - Bella Italia, the latest regionally inspired DLC. From the sun-kissed Tuscan vineyards to the stunning architecture of Rome, industrialists can carve their railway empire across Italy while navigating economic challenges and finding inventive ways to overcome them.  [b]Railway Empire 2 – Bella Italia is now available on Steam, Windows PC, PlayStation®4|5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One for $10.99 with a 10% launch discount for the first seven days on the Epic Games Store, and GOG.com, along with a 10% launch discount for the first 14 days on Steam and the Kalypso Store.[/b]

Steer your fortune in the [b]double steam Mastodonte dei Giovi locomotive and the efficient Signorine FS Class 640 II[/b] as you navigate financial challenges as rocky as the Apennine terrain. Transport [b]over 22 new Italian products, including White Marble and Pasta[/b], to establish networks throughout the region, connecting the rich historical tapestry of Italy on [b]one vast map of the countryside[/b], or [b]on two highly detailed smaller maps of northern and southern Italy[/b]. [b]Three fully voiced and unique comprehensive scenarios[/b] will provide unique challenges and varied approaches for even the most respected tycoon. All this can be enjoyed while listening to the [b]19 new themed musical tracks and jingles[/b] accompanying your journey into the sweet life of Italy.

[b]Railway Empire 2 – Bella Italia is now available on Steam, Windows PC, PlayStation®4|5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One for $10.99 with a 10% launch discount for the first seven days on the Epic Games Store, and GOG.com, along with a 10% launch discount for the first 14 days on Steam and the Kalypso Store.[/b]

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Quality of Life Update 1.3[/h1]

[i]Tycoons![/i]

We have just delivered Railway Empire 2’s Update 1.3 to Steam, Xbox Game Pass across console and PC Game Pass for PC, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One consoles (supported through Smart Delivery).
This update includes the addition of several new shortcuts, an option to hide the UI, and trains now bypassing stations if they didn’t plan to stop at them and the bypass track isn’t too long.

[i]Please find the full Changelog below.[/i]

[h3]Quality of Life Additions[/h3]
[list][*][b][u]Added: More custom shortcuts[/u][/b]
Multiple new keyboard shortcuts have been added to the game. These shortcuts can be viewed and customized in the Key Bindings menu: Options -> Controls -> Keyboard Layout
[list][*]Construct New Rail Line: Z
Open the “Create New Rail Line” panel.
[*]Demolish: ENTF
Opens the demolish panel.
[*]Global Confirm: RETURN
Affects all modal dialogs, as well as in track building.
[*]Cycle Rail Lines + : PgUp
In the World View: Cycle through the trainlines to the right
[*]Cycle Rail Lines - : PgDn
In the World View: Cycle through the trainlines to the left
[*]Adjust rail height + : POS_1
During rail building, while hovering over a rail point, increase the height of the track.
[*]Adjust rail height - : END
During rail building, while hovering over a rail point, decrease the height of the track.
[*]Rotate Building + : I
In building mode, rotates the building to the right.
[*]Rotate Building - : O
In building mode, rotates the building to the left.
[*]Tilt Camera + : Y
Tilts the camera upwards.
[*]Tilt Camera - : X
Tilts the camera downwards.
[*]Open Task List Screen: F2
Opens the Task List Screen.
[*]Open Company Screen: F3
Opens the Company Screen.
[*]Open Research Screen: F4
Opens the Research Screen.
[*]Open Engine Shed Screen: F5
Opens the Engine Shed Screen.
[*]Open Personnel Screen: F6
Opens the Personnel Screen.
[*]Open Multiplayer Screen: F7
Opens the Multiplayer Screen.
[*]Open Rail Lines List: J
Opens the list of all rail lines to the left information interface.
[*]Open City List: K
Opens the list of all cities to the left information interface.
[*]Open Flow of Good: L
Opens the flow of goods display to the left information interface.
[*]Open Additional Overlays: Ö
Opens the additional overlays to the left information interface. [/list]
[*][b][u]Added: Option to hide UI[/u][/b] 
The “Photo mode on/off” option has been added to the key bindings menu. It is now possible to hide the UI by pressing the F11 key.
[*][b][u]Added: New option "Align Railpoints to terrain", where track construction will follow the incline of the terrain rather than cutting straight through every hill and across every drop[/u] [/b]
The “Align Railpoints to terrain” option has been added to the Gameplay options menu. If set to “on”, when placing a “Track Point” on a planned track segment which deviates from the terrain’s height, the “Track Points” height is set to the terrain’s height.
[*][b][u]Added: Trains avoid stations now if they do not plan to stop at that station and if there is a quick way around[/u][/b] 
Then train logic and behavior has been changed. If trains do not plan to stop at a city train station, they will now try to use an alternative track to bypass the city train station. The alternative track must not be too long,  or they will fall back to drive through the train station.
[*][b][u]Added: New “Track utilization” overlay[/u][/b]
The “Track utilization” checkbox has been added to the “Additional Overlay” menu (This menu can be accessed by pressing on the “i” icon in the top left corner of the screen). When this option is turned on, tracks will now be given a colour based on their train usage: from white (low usage) to dark red (high usage).
[*][b][u]Added: New Highlights for tunnels, bridges, and gridirons in track construction[/u][/b] 
While being in “Track Construction” mode, certain track parts are now coloured differently to allow for a better distinction between them. Gridirons are now coloured in an orange & white dashed line, Tunnels in a purple & white dashed line, and Bridges in a blue & white dashed line.
[*][b][u]Added: New “Connected citizens” metric to company overview[/u][/b] 
The “Connected Citizens” information has been added to the “Company” menu. The number of citizens connected by the player will now be displayed there.
[*][b][u]Added: New “Number of businesses” metric to “Flow of goods”[/u] [/b]
The “Number of businesses” information has been added to the “Flow of Goods” menu. When selecting a resource, the total number of businesses located on the map is displayed there.
[*][b][u]Added: New Option to hide rail line information window while a train is focused[/u][/b] 
While having a train selected, a new “Retract” button is now available to hide the UI. The button is located below the “Delete Rail Line” button.
[*][b][u]Added: New “Apply to all” button to maintenance post window[/u][/b]
The “Transfer to All” button has been added to the “Maintenance Post” menu. The button behaves the same as the “Transfer to All” button from the Maintenance depot. When clicking this button, the current settings of the selected building are applied to all other buildings of the same type.
[*][b][u]Added: Path of goods through warehouses to “Flow of goods”[/u] [/b]
When selecting resources in the “Flow of Goods” menu, the overlay now also shows the path of goods through warehouses.
[*][b][u]Added: New ”Number of citizens” metric to city list[/u][/b]
When selecting “Cities” in the “City List” menu, the number of “Citizens” is now displayed below each city name.
[*][b][u]Added: Last camera position in ”Ride along” mode is now saved[/u] [/b]
The last camera position used during a “Ride Along” is now saved when leaving and reentering this mode.
[*][b][u]Added: After adding a new station building, the buildings information window will open so that the player can make adjustments to the new building [/u][/b]
After building a new extension at a train station through the “Construction Extension” menu, the newly created building’s overlay is now immediately displayed.
[*][b][u]Added: New ”Switch between cities” arrow buttons in the city information window[/u] [/b]
When selecting an owned city, arrow icons to switch between player owned cities are now displayed in the city overlay next to the its name.
[*][b][u]Added: New arrows showcasing connections between rail line stops when constructing/viewing a rail line [/u][/b]
While creating or editing a new rail line, the connections between train stations are now additionally indicated with arrows pointing between the different connections.
[*][b][u]Added: New Option to adjust volume of locomotive sounds[/u] [/b]
The “Trains” sound slider has been added to the Sound Options menu. The sound volume of trains can now be separately adjusted via this menu.
[*][b][u]Added: Currently selected train is now highlighted in Rail Lines overview [/u][/b]
When selecting a train, the corresponding train in the “Rail Lines” menu will now be highlighted with an arrow pointer.
[*][b][u]Added: New Warning in rail line information window if prioritized goods couldn't be transported (automatic loading)[/u][/b]
A new warning has been added if a rail line is unable to transport prioritized goods. When hovering over the exclamation mark, a detailed message with the reason why the prioritized good can’t be transported is now displayed.

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Update 1.1[/h1]

[i]Tycoons![/i]

We have just delivered Railway Empire 2’s massive Update 1.1 for Steam, Xbox Game Pass across console and PC Game Pass for PC, the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 4|5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles (supported through Smart Delivery):
When Railway Empire 2 was released, a lot of you expressed a desire for more control regarding your signals. We have been working hard to respond to your wishes, and with this update we have implemented the ability to choose how you place your signals. [b]Automatic signaling mode[/b] with track directions is the recommended way to play Railway Empire 2, but for those of you who would prefer to take full control over your Railway system, the new [b]"Manual" mode[/b] can now be selected at the start of a new game. Please note that you have to select one of the two systems at the start of a game and these modes cannot be changed afterwards and are incompatible with each other.

We have also implemented some [b]additional tweaks to the train logic[/b], [b]Interface[/b] and, among other things, have [b]added the option to play your game at x5 speed[/b] (PC Only). Furthermore, we have added [b]improvements to the warehouses[/b] to address goods that did not reach their destination.

[i]Please find the full Changelog below.[/i]

[h3]Signals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added manual Signal Mode as a separate game mode where the player can place signals manually:

[list][*] When starting a new game, you can now choose between two different signal modes: "Automatic (recommended)" and "Manual". Since the two systems are incompatible with each other, you must decide at the beginning of a game and cannot change the mode during a running game.
[*] In "Manual" mode you may place individual "stop" and "directional" signals, or place several signals at once within a certain distance. You can also remove all signals on a track section.
[*] All signals allow a train to wait at them if the next signal section is used by another train. Sometimes trains stop at signals even though the next section is free to avoid blockages. "Directional signals" allow trains to pass in one direction only, "Stop signals" may be used in both directions and are primarily intended to divide long tracks into several sections.
[*] This mode is intended for more experienced players, as with great power comes great responsibility: If you do not set up your signals correctly, blockages will occur! [/list]
[*] Fixed a bug where signals did not update on competitors track properly, after the AI has built new tracks, resulting in sub optimal signal placement.
[*] Fixed signal positioning at gridirons so that signals no longer spawn in the middle of the track.
[/list]

[h3]Warehouse[/h3]
These fixes address reported issues of "trains not delivering goods" and "goods not reaching their destination".

[*] The farther away a factory or farm from a well-supplied city, the less likely it is, that goods will be delivered to that city. If a city is undersupplied, goods will be delivered anyway.

[*] Added option to skip non-tutorial voice messages from characters.
[*] Added option to adjust scroll speed.
[*] Moved the "Icons at Edge of Screen" option from “Display” to “Gameplay “
[/list]

[list]

[*] Users are now able to input non-Latin-alphabet text.
[*] Maintenance costs are now properly displayed in the quarterly report.
[/list]

[*] Fixed a bug where AI competitors would participate in auctions even if 100% of their shares were owned by the player.
[*] Further stability improvements and smaller bugfixes.

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 - Hotfix for Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 - Hotfix for Update 1.0.3 [/h1]


[i]Tycoons,[/i]

We have just released a Hotfix for Update 1.0.3, which readjusted and fixed the priority of delivering wares and we wanted to share some additional insights with you all.
The issues noticed were mainly related to the calculation of priority in the underlying code and now that it is fixed we wanted to take a moment to elaborate on how it is decided which good goes where and why first.

At the start of their journey, the following is considered for the wares:
The assessment is based on the nearest city that has a demand for the goods, whose import storage is not full and can be reached by the current city.
Already declared goods in the cities and goods consumed during the scheduled travel time are also taken into account.
[b]The priority of cities in need of goods is decided via 2 factors: [/b]
[olist]
[*]The most important factor is the distance the goods would need to travel to reach their target. This refers to the length of the rail connecting the starting point and goal, not the direct distance. For reference: the length of a station is 200 meters.
[*]In case this distance is similiar in length, the amount of times the goods would have to change trains is also taken into account. The higher this number is, the lower the priority of the city. [/olist]

Based on this, the following Formula applies:
[i]1 – D / 5000 – U / 10[/i]

D = Distance in meters to the destination, counting the length of the tracks leading there, not their actual distance
U = Amount of track changes that would be needed, due to warehouses and goods changing trains

With this formula/prioritization for prioritization laid out, the goods would be delivered to each city, until the storage of the city is full and then proceed to reserve goods for the next city in the priority line.

[b]To summarize, this means that, the closer the city expecting the goods is to the warehouse and the more direct the connection is without warehouses, the more priority is given. The distance value is the most important[/b]. 

[i]In case there is still something that you think is working incorrectly about the warehouses after the update, please report it to us in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1644320/discussions/2/]Bug-Report Subforum[/url], so we can have a closer look at it![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1644320/view/3672170635430641775?l=english

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 – Railway-Academy
notes.content:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 – Railway-Academy[/h1]

[b]Welcome to the official Railway-Academy, Tycoons! In this post, we will provide you with a few suggestions on how to solve some of the most common questions asked about Railway Empire 2. We hope they will help you enjoy Railway Empire 2 even more![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42842808/838a4eb6e952ca51506caa1bd84c77fa86dfb51c.gif[/img]

[h2][u]Why can I not stockpile goods at a warehouse?[/u][/h2]
[list][*] In Railway Empire 2 we have changed the way goods are distributed: Unlike in the predecessor, every transported good gets assigned a final destination when starting its journey. This way goods can switch rail lines with the help of warehouses and get to their different destinations independently. Goods are therefore never sent to a warehouse for storage, but only for transit to an already known destination.[/list]

[h2][u]Why are my trains not running?[/u][/h2]
[h3]Missing station gridiron or missing switch[/h3]
[list][*] In general, trains must be able to return to their initial station. If the tracks are given directions, then the trains need the ability to move from one track to another. This necessitates a station gridiron or switches on both ends of the track.[/list]
[h3]Minimum required wagons are set above zero[/h3]
[list][*] Maybe you changed the minimum number of wagons while editing the rail line. If the train is ordered to only depart once a certain number of wagons have been loaded, then it will wait until that number is reached. [/list]
[h3]Problem with route[/h3]
[list][*] If the warning “Problem with route” is shown at the rail line, the route could not be created and the trains cannot be deployed. This also means there is an unresolved issue with the route. See “Why is there a problem with route?” below.[/list]
[h3]Trains waiting for deployment[/h3]
[list][*] There is something preventing the train deployment. For specifics, see “Why are my trains waiting for deployment?” below.[/list]

[h2][u]Why are my trains running empty?[/u][/h2]
[h3]No goods are being requested[/h3]
[list][*] Trains only load cargo once there is a demand for it. Goods without demand will not be loaded. For specifics, see “Why is good X not requested?” below.[/list]
[h3]Production is halted[/h3]
[list][*] It is possible that your factory is running out of raw resources or the export Warehouse reaches its maximum capacity.[/list]
[h3]Production is slow[/h3]
[list][*] Consider buying and expanding the site, or simply waiting. Normally, businesses owned by the AI automatically expands after some months running at full efficiency.[/list]
[h3]No goods in storage (Rural business, factory or warehouse)[/h3]
[list][*] If no goods are present, no goods can be transported.[/list]
[h3]The demand is fulfilled by a different rail line[/h3]
[list][*] It is possible that another rail line is already fulfilling the demand.[/list]
[h2]Waypoint error[/h2]
[list][*] There may be a misplaced waypoint somewhere along the route, that messes with your trains.
[*] Please check your waypoints carefully again, there might be a misplaced one along the route.[/list]

[h2][u]Why are my trains “waiting for goods” for a long time?[/u][/h2]
There are a few reasons why your trains might fall short of the minimum amount of wagons you have set:
[h3]Production is halted or slow[/h3]
[list][*] See above:  “Production is halted” or “Production is slow”.[/list]
[h3]No goods are being requested[/h3]
[list][*] There is something preventing your goods from being requested by a destination. For specifics, see below.[/list]

[h2][u]Why are my trains “waiting for deployment”?[/u] [/h2]
[h3]Minimum spacing between trains of the same rail line[/h3]
[list][*] Trains of the same rail line will try to keep a reasonable distance between each other. To avoid blocking a track, a new train is not deployed until the distance is large enough.[/list]
[h3]Too much traffic at the station[/h3]
[list][*] There is no free track for the train to be deployed on or the free tracks are already reserved by existing trains on the way to that station. [/list]

[h2][u]Why is there a “problem with route”?[/u][/h2]
[h3]Missing station gridiron or missing switch[/h3]
[list][*] In general, trains must be able to return to their initial station. If the tracks are given directions, then the trains need the ability to move from one track to another. This necessitates a station gridiron or switches on both ends of the tracks.[/list]
[h3]Track directions only go one way or are conflicting[/h3]
[list][*] Perhaps a train cannot follow its route because the track directions you have set would cause a conflict.[/list]
[h3]A track is missing[/h3]
[list][*] Maybe a track was deleted after the route was created[/list]
[h3]A train station was deleted but the route was not adjusted[/h3]
[list][*] When a station is replaced, it might not be recognized by the initial route. In such a case edit the rail line to fix the issue.[/list]

[h2][u]Why is a specific good not being requested?[/u][/h2]
[h3]City is not big enough[/h3]
[list][*] Certain goods are only demanded once a specific population level has been reached. To check this, select the city and open the list “Goods Supply and Demand”.[/list]
[h3]There is an oversupply[/h3]
[list][*] If a city has reached its maximum stock for a good, the demand will hold until it had time to consume. [/list]
[h3]A competitor is fulfilling the demand[/h3]
[list][*] There might be a competitor delivering the same good. Goods in delivery are counted as goods in stock.[/list]

[h2][u]Why is a specific good not being transported?[/u][/h2]
[h3]A sufficient number of goods is already on its way[/h3]
[list][*] A city will only request a certain number of goods at the same time. Goods in delivery are counted as goods in stock.[/list]
[h3]Another rail line is shorter by more than 25%[/h3]
[list][*] If there is another rail line passing the same station, goods may use both unless one is 25% shorter than the other.[/list]
[h3]Not enough train capacity[/h3]
[list][*] A single train only has eight wagons and needs some time to transport its goods. If it cannot keep up with the demands of the supply some goods will not be transported.[/list]

[h2][u]Why are goods getting stuck at the warehouse?[/u][/h2]
[h3]Not enough train capacity between the warehouse and the destination[/h3]
[list][*] A single train only has eight wagons and needs some time to transport its goods. If it cannot keep up with the demands of the supply some goods will not be transported.[/list]
[h3]Something happened to the rail line that was supposed to transport the goods to the destination[/h3]
[list][*] If something disrupts a rail line, goods in the warehouse aren’t automatically reset. You can always reset the goods in the warehouse by deleting and re-adding the selected good type.[/list]

[h2][u]Why is my new, more efficient, route not delivering the goods it’s supposed to be?[/u][/h2]
[h3]Another rail line is more than 25% percent shorter[/h3]
[h3]A sufficient shipment of goods is already on its way[/h3]
[list][*] A city will only request a certain number of goods at the same time. Goods in delivery are counted as goods in stock.[/list]
[h3]A sufficient shipment of goods is stuck at a warehouse[/h3]
[list][*] It is possible that a number of requested goods arrive at a warehouse, but then aren’t transported to a city. For specifics see above.[/list]

[b]In case you encounter a gameplay issue not mentioned above, or none of the mentioned solutions helped you resolve the situation, please send a message to support@kalypsomedia.com. Please provide them with a Description of your issue, a DxDiag.txt and the affected savegame. You can find all the necessary information on how to acquire these things in the Technical FAQ [/b] 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1644320/discussions/2/3843304884848397475/

notes.title: Track to Release - From Beta Station to Release City
notes.content:
[h1]Take a look back on our journey to release![/h1]

Tycoons,
 
The ride towards our destination “Release City” was an exciting one for us, and we’d like to recap our journey and have a look at the ride so far.
From December 6th to 20th in 2022, we had an exciting closed beta to which far more players applied than we expected. Seeing the enthusiasm for the game this far ahead of release was inspiring for us!

 The detailed and plentiful feedback we have received has been carefully evaluated, along with all the constructive criticism and helpful suggestions that were given to us by our community during our Beta.

 Below, you can have a glimpse at some of these major changes, already implemented as a result of Beta player’s feedback, with many more for you to be excited about at the Railway Empire 2 Release-Station:
 

[h2]Important Changes[/h2]
As any good train ride needs a well-built track, we have implemented some important changes to ensure the ride will be a smooth one and live up to our passengers' high expectations.
[list]
[*]Custom Game settings are now more advanced to provide a more customisable experience. Please stay tuned, more details will follow, but just to spoil a few of them: You can now choose the Inflation Rate, Transportation Revenue, the cost of tracks and Maintenance, among other things.
[*]The warehouse can now be unlocked right at the start of the campaign. Originally this was a lot further down the tech tree, but your feedback underlined the importance of this strategically essential building.
[*]We have implemented a dynamic technology tree wherein older technologies might become available for purchase or through events. 
[*]The time for bidding is now longer, to make sure you can take your time to carefully read through the auction details.
[*]Sandbox maps now have the option to be played without a time limit.
[*]After numerous requests, double track building has now been added! It is as simple as pressing a single button after creating a track as usual.
[*]Track crossings are now possible.
[*]You can now quickly recognise and distinguish between freight and post/passenger trains via additional symbols in the track lists.
[*]To make it clear at which size a new industry building gets unlocked in a town, we have made that information visible to the player.
[*]We have made it clearer that you need a university to grow your city if you already filled the special city slot with another building like the library. [/list]

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
Furthermore, we have been working on improvements to the quality of life of your gameplay experience, to make sure you find the ride enjoyable. Below you can find some examples of these changes:
[list]
[*]Auctions can now be minimized so that you have the chance to issue a bond to pay for it.
[*]Windows can now be closed by using the Escape button to be more in line with player expectations.
[*]An arrow now gives a visual indicator on the currently selected object (e.g. a train or a building)
[*]Added automatic savegames when a task group was completed, so that the player can fall back to when each set of tasks were completed.
[*]Three different font size settings have been added to improve readability.
[*]You can now fully cycle through the number of cars in the train set-up on your train from 8 down to 0.
[*]Additional customizable keyboard shortcuts have been added (e.g. build supply tower, build train station, etc)

notes.title: Railway Empire 2 FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]Railway Empire 2 FAQ[/h1]

[b]Genre[/b]
[i]Tycoon Simulation[/i] 
[b]Release[/b] 
[i]May 25th 2023[/i] 
[b]Platforms [/b]
[i]PC, PlayStation 4 | 5 and Xbox Series S | X and Xbox One. 
A Nintendo Switch version will follow later this year. [/i]


[h2]What is Railway Empire 2? [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42842808/128b629e68c77077a03b99ecdca330b625234324.gif[/img]
 
All aboard the express train to riches and fame in [b][i]Railway Empire 2[/i][/b]! Don the coat of a clever entrepreneur, take over a small railway company in the early 1800s and turn your steam engines into the workhorses of the economy. Grow your company into the largest railway company of the continent and outsmart your competitors as you [b][i]connect cities and companies with an ever-expanding network[/i][/b] of rail lines, bridges, and tunnels. [b][i]60 famous locomotives[/i][/b] are at your disposal, all pulling freight and passenger cars as [b][i]they usher in an era of historic importance[/i][/b] during the Industrial Revolution. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42842808/eaa5d0fa13286a98badd1b35ee543980d7118c94.gif[/img]


Railway Empire 2 features [b][i]bigger, more detailed and lively maps[/i][/b] than ever before. The [b][i]whole of the US and continental Europe[/i][/b] are covered in two huge, sprawling maps, whilst more detailed maps put the focus on specific regions of each continent. * [b][i]Improved track construction[/i][/b] helps you focus on the important decisions as you drive the economy and help the growth of the cities. Signals are placed automatically, bridges can hold up to 4 tracks, and the expandable train stations can now have up to 8 tracks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42842808/00e6faad5b05cd119f56388183a36baf536f2a0d.gif[/img]


[b][i]Choose from 6 different characters[/i][/b] to lead your railway company, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Play the [b][i]5-chapter campaign[/i][/b] or choose from any of the [b][i]14 different scenarios[/i][/b]. Set your own difficulty in the fully customisable [b][i]Free Play mode[/i][/b] or build the perfect rail network in [b][i]construction mode[/i][/b]. 

*[i] For the Nintendo Switch version, the maps are segmented.[/i] 


[h2]What are the main features of Railway Empire 2? [/h2]
[list]
[*] Railroad tycoon with AI opponents. 
[*] Co-op mode for up to 4 players. *
*[i]This does not include the Switch version of Railway Empire 2.[/i] 
[*] More than 13 million square kilometres are your playground to build a huge railway empire. 
[*] 16 maps, with 8 covering America and 8 covering Europe. Two of the maps will let you expand your railway empire across the entire continent. *
*[i] For the Nintendo Switch version, the maps are segmented.[/i] 
[*] 60 detailed and historically accurate engines.  
[*] Starts with the easy-track train mode and becomes a complex transport simulation. 
[*] Remote view for planning and 30,000x zoomed-in close-up view for amazing details. 
[*] Enjoy the ride on your own trains and experience your railway empire up close.  
[*] Campaign Mode. 
[*] Free Play Mode – select the rules and the challenges you want. 
[*] Sandbox Mode – do whatever you want without any restrictions. 
[*] Improved track construction. 
[*] Paint your locomotives. 
[/list]


[h2]Railway Empire 2 in numbers [/h2]
[list]
[*] A 5-chapter campaign. 
[*] 14 different scenarios. 
[*] Co-op with up to 4 players. *
*[i]This does not include the Switch version of Railway Empire 2.[/i] 
[*] 60 locomotives. 
[*] Continent-spanning maps: the map of Europe or the map of North America result in a total in more than 13 million square kilometers for your Railway Empire. *
*[i] For the Nintendo Switch version, the maps are segmented. [/i]
[*] 269 cities
[*] 8 tracks for stations
[*] ∞ parallel tracks * 
[*] ∞ tracks for bridges *
*[i]Those features might not be available or differ for the Nintendo Switch version. [/i]
[/list] 


[h2]When will Railway Empire 2 be released? [/h2]

Railway Empire 2 is on track for May 25th 2023, when the title will be released day one with Xbox Game Pass for console and PC! It will also be available on Xbox Series X|S consoles, Xbox One, Windows PC and PlayStation 4|5. A Nintendo Switch™ version will follow later this year.

 
[h2]Who is developing Railway Empire 2? [/h2]

Railway Empire 2 is being developed by Gaming Minds, located in Gütersloh, Germany. They are known for games like the Patrician series, the Port Royale series, and of course, [b]Railway Empire[/b]! 


[h2]What Game Modes are available? [/h2]

[h3][b]Campaign Mode[/b] [/h3]
There will, again, be a campaign with 5 chapters. It spans over the different eras and is set in both the USA and Europe. 

 
[h3][b]Scenarios[/b] [/h3]
Challenge yourself in 14 different and exciting scenarios and compete for a top spot in the online leaderboards. Are you up for the competition? Who will be the greatest tycoon the Railway Empire community has ever seen? 


[h3][b]Custom game[/b] [/h3]
Freedom is the theme of this mode! Choose your starting options and challenge yourself in whichever way you want to. The true endless Railway Empire 2 experience! 

 
[h3][b]Sandbox Mode[/b] [/h3]
Unlimited money, no competitors and no tasks! The ultimate laid-back experience to build your dream railway empire has become a reality! Cover a whole continent in tracks and expand to your heart’s content! Nothing restricts you!  


[h3][b]Multiplayer Mode *[/b][/h3]
In the brand-new cooperative multiplayer mode for up to four players, you can team up with other tycoons. You can even join in later if your train is late. Jump straight into the action of your friends' games. 
*[i]This does not include the Switch version of Railway Empire 2. [/i]


[h2]Will it be possible to play the whole of the US or the European continent at once? [/h2]

Yes, the whole of the US and continental Europe are covered with two huge, sprawling maps. *

*[i]This does not include the Switch version of Railway Empire 2.[/i] 


[h2]Will players be able to customize cities /railway stations? [/h2]

Depending on the size of the city and your financial situation, you will be able to build factories or other producing facilities there. With enough money, you will also be able to build special buildings like universities and landmarks. In the scenario that a building slot is already covered, you can then purchase the building via auction.  
Railway Stations can be expanded to accommodate more trains and tracks and can also be fitted with useful extensions.
